parts.name: statement
parts.prose: IEC 62443 SR 1.2 RE 1 SL%v (IAC): ICS system '%v' devices do not have unique identifiers. All IACS devices must have unique IDs at SL 2+.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: No centralized account management. IACS accounts must be centrally managed, reviewed, and deprovisioned promptly.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: ICS system '%v' has no periodic account review process. Accounts must be reviewed regularly for continued business need.

controls.title: IEC 62443 SR 1.3 RE 1 SL%v (IAC): No unified account management policy across all IACS components. Required at Security Level 2+.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: IEC 62443 SR 1.3 RE 1 SL%v (IAC): No unified account management policy across all IACS components. Required at Security Level 2+.

controls.title: ICS system '%v' uses unchanged default credentials. Default identifiers are a critical vulnerability — change all defaults before deployment.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: ICS system '%v' uses unchanged default credentials. Default identifiers are a critical vulnerability — change all defaults before deployment.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: IACS does not prevent identifier reuse for a defined period. Deactivated identifiers must not be reassigned for at least 90 days.

controls.title: ICS system '%v' has no authenticator lifecycle management. Passwords, keys, and tokens must have defined issuance, rotation, and revocation policies.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: ICS system '%v' has no authenticator lifecycle management. Passwords, keys, and tokens must have defined issuance, rotation, and revocation policies.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: Authenticators are not distributed via secure channels. Initial credentials must be delivered through a secure out-of-band mechanism.

controls.title: ICS system '%v' has unencrypted wireless access. All wireless connections to IACS must use strong authentication and encryption.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: ICS system '%v' has unencrypted wireless access. All wireless connections to IACS must use strong authentication and encryption.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: ICS system '%v' wireless access lacks authentication. Mutual authentication is required for all IACS wireless connections.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: No wireless access policy for IACS. A documented policy defining allowed wireless use is required.

controls.title: ICS system '%v' has minimum password length of %v characters. Minimum 8 characters required (12+ recommended for SL 2+).

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: ICS system '%v' has minimum password length of %v characters. Minimum 8 characters required (12+ recommended for SL 2+).

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: ICS system '%v' does not enforce password complexity. Passwords must include uppercase, lowercase, digits, and special characters.

controls.title: IEC 62443 SR 1.7 RE 1 SL%v (IAC): ICS system '%v' has minimum password length of %v. Minimum 12 characters required at Security Level 2+.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: IEC 62443 SR 1.7 RE 1 SL%v (IAC): ICS system '%v' has minimum password length of %v. Minimum 12 characters required at Security Level 2+.

controls.title: IEC 62443 SR 1.8 SL%v (IAC): PKI/certificate-based authentication is not implemented. Required at Security Level 3+ for strong identity assurance.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: IEC 62443 SR 1.8 SL%v (IAC): PKI/certificate-based authentication is not implemented. Required at Security Level 3+ for strong identity assurance.

controls.title: Certificate revocation checking (CRL/OCSP) is not implemented. Revoked certificates must be detected and rejected.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Certificate revocation checking (CRL/OCSP) is not implemented. Revoked certificates must be detected and rejected.

controls.title: Public key authentication uses weak cryptographic algorithms. Use RSA 2048+, ECDSA 256+, or equivalent strength algorithms.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Public key authentication uses weak cryptographic algorithms. Use RSA 2048+, ECDSA 256+, or equivalent strength algorithms.

controls.title: ICS system '%v' displays authenticator feedback in plaintext. Authentication information (passwords, tokens) must be obscured during entry.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: ICS system '%v' displays authenticator feedback in plaintext. Authentication information (passwords, tokens) must be obscured during entry.

controls.title: ICS system '%v' allows %v failed login attempts before lockout. Threshold must be 10 or fewer.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: ICS system '%v' allows %v failed login attempts before lockout. Threshold must be 10 or fewer.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: ICS system '%v' has no account lockout policy. Account lockout after failed attempts is required.

controls.title: IEC 62443 SR 1.11 RE 1 SL%v (IAC): ICS system '%v' allows %v failed login attempts. Threshold must be 5 or fewer at Security Level 2+.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: IEC 62443 SR 1.11 RE 1 SL%v (IAC): ICS system '%v' allows %v failed login attempts. Threshold must be 5 or fewer at Security Level 2+.

controls.title: ICS system '%v' does not display a system use notification. A warning banner indicating authorized use only must be displayed before login.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: ICS system '%v' does not display a system use notification. A warning banner indicating authorized use only must be displayed before login.

controls.title: ICS system '%v' has uncontrolled remote access. Remote access via untrusted networks must use VPN, jump host, or equivalent controls.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: ICS system '%v' has uncontrolled remote access. Remote access via untrusted networks must use VPN, jump host, or equivalent controls.

controls.title: IEC 62443 SR 1.13 RE 1 SL%v (IAC): ICS system '%v' remote access does not enforce MFA. Multi-factor authentication is required for all remote IACS access at SL 2+.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: IEC 62443 SR 1.13 RE 1 SL%v (IAC): ICS system '%v' remote access does not enforce MFA. Multi-factor authentication is required for all remote IACS access at SL 2+.

controls.title: ICS system '%v' does not enforce least privilege. Users must only have the access rights required to perform their authorized functions.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: ICS system '%v' does not enforce least privilege. Users must only have the access rights required to perform their authorized functions.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: Privileged access is not audited. All privileged actions on IACS must generate an audit record.

controls.title: IEC 62443 SR 2.1 RE 1 SL%v (UC): Role-based access control (RBAC) is not implemented. Separate authorization roles are required at Security Level 2+.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: IEC 62443 SR 2.1 RE 1 SL%v (UC): Role-based access control (RBAC) is not implemented. Separate authorization roles are required at Security Level 2+.

controls.title: IEC 62443 SR 2.1 RE 2 SL%v (UC): No dual-approval mechanism for high-impact IACS actions. Required at Security Level 3+ for critical system changes.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: IEC 62443 SR 2.1 RE 2 SL%v (UC): No dual-approval mechanism for high-impact IACS actions. Required at Security Level 3+ for critical system changes.

controls.title: Wireless use on ICS system '%v' is not explicitly authorized. All wireless connections must be documented and approved.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Wireless use on ICS system '%v' is not explicitly authorized. All wireless connections must be documented and approved.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: Wireless connections on ICS system '%v' are not monitored. Wireless activity must be continuously monitored for unauthorized access.

controls.title: ICS system '%v' has no portable/mobile device use policy. USB drives, laptops, and tablets connecting to IACS must be governed by a formal policy.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: ICS system '%v' has no portable/mobile device use policy. USB drives, laptops, and tablets connecting to IACS must be governed by a formal policy.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: ICS system '%v' does not control removable media. Removable media must be scanned for malware before use and restricted to authorized devices.

controls.title: IEC 62443 SR 2.3 RE 1 SL%v (UC): Portable device authorizations are not centrally managed. Centralized control is required at Security Level 2+.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: IEC 62443 SR 2.3 RE 1 SL%v (UC): Portable device authorizations are not centrally managed. Centralized control is required at Security Level 2+.

controls.title: ICS system '%v' does not control mobile code execution. Scripts, active content, and macros must be restricted to explicitly authorized code.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: ICS system '%v' does not control mobile code execution. Scripts, active content, and macros must be restricted to explicitly authorized code.

controls.title: IEC 62443 SR 2.4 RE 1 SL%v (UC): ICS system '%v' has neither application whitelisting nor malware protection. One of these is required at Security Level 2+.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: IEC 62443 SR 2.4 RE 1 SL%v (UC): ICS system '%v' has neither application whitelisting nor malware protection. One of these is required at Security Level 2+.

controls.title: ICS system '%v' session lock timeout is %v minutes. Maximum inactivity timeout before lock must be 30 minutes or less.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: ICS system '%v' session lock timeout is %v minutes. Maximum inactivity timeout before lock must be 30 minutes or less.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: ICS system '%v' does not enforce session locking. Automatic session lock after inactivity is required.

controls.title: IEC 62443 SR 2.5 RE 1 SL%v (UC): ICS system '%v' session lock timeout is %v minutes. Maximum 15 minutes is required at Security Level 2+.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: IEC 62443 SR 2.5 RE 1 SL%v (UC): ICS system '%v' session lock timeout is %v minutes. Maximum 15 minutes is required at Security Level 2+.

controls.title: ICS system '%v' does not support remote session termination. Authorized users must be able to terminate remote sessions at any time.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: ICS system '%v' does not support remote session termination. Authorized users must be able to terminate remote sessions at any time.

controls.title: IEC 62443 SR 2.7 SL%v (UC): ICS system '%v' has no concurrent session limit. Limiting concurrent sessions reduces the risk of session hijacking.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: IEC 62443 SR 2.7 SL%v (UC): ICS system '%v' has no concurrent session limit. Limiting concurrent sessions reduces the risk of session hijacking.

controls.title: IEC 62443 SR 2.7 RE 1 SL%v (UC): ICS system '%v' allows up to %v concurrent sessions. Strict session limits (≤3) are recommended at Security Level 3+.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: IEC 62443 SR 2.7 RE 1 SL%v (UC): ICS system '%v' allows up to %v concurrent sessions. Strict session limits (≤3) are recommended at Security Level 3+.

controls.title: ICS system '%v' does not have audit logging enabled. Security-relevant events must be logged: login attempts, privilege use, configuration changes, and errors.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: ICS system '%v' does not have audit logging enabled. Security-relevant events must be logged: login attempts, privilege use, configuration changes, and errors.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: ICS system '%v' audit logs are missing required fields. Logs must include: event type, timestamp, source identity, outcome, and affected resource.

controls.title: IEC 62443 SR 2.8 RE 1 SL%v (UC): Audit logs are not centrally collected. Centralized log aggregation is required at Security Level 2+ to enable correlation.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: IEC 62443 SR 2.8 RE 1 SL%v (UC): Audit logs are not centrally collected. Centralized log aggregation is required at Security Level 2+ to enable correlation.

controls.title: Audit log storage capacity is insufficient. The system must allocate sufficient storage and alert when approaching capacity limits.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Audit log storage capacity is insufficient. The system must allocate sufficient storage and alert when approaching capacity limits.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: IACS audit logs are retained for only %v days. Minimum 90-day retention is required (1 year recommended for regulatory compliance).

controls.title: No alerting for audit processing failures. The system must alert personnel when audit subsystem failures occur (storage full, process crash, etc.).

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: No alerting for audit processing failures. The system must alert personnel when audit subsystem failures occur (storage full, process crash, etc.).

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: No defined response procedure for audit processing failures. A documented response procedure is required.

controls.title: IACS timestamps are not synchronized. All systems must use a reliable time source (NTP/PTP) to ensure audit record integrity.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: IACS timestamps are not synchronized. All systems must use a reliable time source (NTP/PTP) to ensure audit record integrity.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: ICS system '%v' does not have NTP configured. Accurate timestamps are required for audit trail integrity and incident correlation.

controls.title: IEC 62443 SR 2.12 SL%v (UC): ICS system '%v' does not provide non-repudiation. Cryptographic signing or equivalent mechanism is required at Security Level 2+ for critical actions.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: IEC 62443 SR 2.12 SL%v (UC): ICS system '%v' does not provide non-repudiation. Cryptographic signing or equivalent mechanism is required at Security Level 2+ for critical actions.

controls.title: ICS system '%v' does not protect communication integrity. IACS communications must use mechanisms (checksums, MACs, digital signatures) to detect unauthorized modification.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: ICS system '%v' does not protect communication integrity. IACS communications must use mechanisms (checksums, MACs, digital signatures) to detect unauthorized modification.

controls.title: IEC 62443 SR 3.1 RE 1 SL%v (SI): ICS system '%v' does not use cryptographic mechanisms for communication integrity. HMAC or digital signatures are required at Security Level 2+.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: IEC 62443 SR 3.1 RE 1 SL%v (SI): ICS system '%v' does not use cryptographic mechanisms for communication integrity. HMAC or digital signatures are required at Security Level 2+.

controls.title: IEC 62443 SR 3.2 SL%v (SI): ICS system '%v' has neither malware protection nor application whitelisting. One of these controls is required at Security Level 2+.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: IEC 62443 SR 3.2 SL%v (SI): ICS system '%v' has neither malware protection nor application whitelisting. One of these controls is required at Security Level 2+.

controls.title: ICS system '%v' malware definitions are not current. Malware signatures must be updated at least weekly, or more frequently if the system is Internet-connected.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: ICS system '%v' malware definitions are not current. Malware signatures must be updated at least weekly, or more frequently if the system is Internet-connected.

controls.title: IEC 62443 SR 3.2 RE 1 SL%v (SI): Malware protection is not deployed at all IACS network entry points. Boundary-level malware scanning is required at Security Level 3+.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: IEC 62443 SR 3.2 RE 1 SL%v (SI): Malware protection is not deployed at all IACS network entry points. Boundary-level malware scanning is required at Security Level 3+.

controls.title: ICS system '%v' has no security function verification process. Security controls must be periodically tested to confirm they operate as intended.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: ICS system '%v' has no security function verification process. Security controls must be periodically tested to confirm they operate as intended.

controls.title: IEC 62443 SR 3.3 RE 1 SL%v (SI): No documented schedule for security function verification. A formal testing schedule is required at Security Level 2+.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: IEC 62443 SR 3.3 RE 1 SL%v (SI): No documented schedule for security function verification. A formal testing schedule is required at Security Level 2+.

controls.title: ICS system '%v' does not verify software integrity. File integrity monitoring or hash verification must be implemented to detect unauthorized changes.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: ICS system '%v' does not verify software integrity. File integrity monitoring or hash verification must be implemented to detect unauthorized changes.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: ICS system '%v' does not verify firmware integrity. Firmware must be verified against known-good hashes before and after updates.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: No patch management process documented. Security patches for IACS components must be evaluated and applied through a controlled process.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: Critical IACS patches are delayed up to %v days. Critical security patches must be evaluated within 30 days and applied within 90 days.

controls.title: IEC 62443 SR 3.4 RE 1 SL%v (SI): ICS system '%v' lacks automated integrity checking. Automated file integrity monitoring is required at Security Level 2+.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: IEC 62443 SR 3.4 RE 1 SL%v (SI): ICS system '%v' lacks automated integrity checking. Automated file integrity monitoring is required at Security Level 2+.

controls.title: ICS system '%v' does not validate inputs. All external inputs (HMI, APIs, data feeds) must be validated to prevent injection attacks and unexpected behavior.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: ICS system '%v' does not validate inputs. All external inputs (HMI, APIs, data feeds) must be validated to prevent injection attacks and unexpected behavior.

controls.title: ICS system '%v' does not enforce output range checking. Control outputs must remain within safe operational bounds even under error or attack conditions.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: ICS system '%v' does not enforce output range checking. Control outputs must remain within safe operational bounds even under error or attack conditions.

controls.title: ICS system '%v' does not implement secure error handling. Errors must not expose sensitive information and must fail to a known safe state.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: ICS system '%v' does not implement secure error handling. Errors must not expose sensitive information and must fail to a known safe state.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: ICS system '%v' error messages expose sensitive system information. Error messages must be sanitized before display to operators.

controls.title: ICS system '%v' does not protect session integrity. Session tokens must be cryptographically protected against hijacking and replay attacks.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: ICS system '%v' does not protect session integrity. Session tokens must be cryptographically protected against hijacking and replay attacks.

controls.title: IEC 62443 SR 3.8 RE 1 SL%v (SI): ICS system '%v' does not invalidate sessions when privileges change. Sessions must be re-established after any privilege modification.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: IEC 62443 SR 3.8 RE 1 SL%v (SI): ICS system '%v' does not invalidate sessions when privileges change. Sessions must be re-established after any privilege modification.

controls.title: ICS system '%v' audit logs are not tamper-protected. Audit records must be write-protected and access-controlled to preserve their evidential value.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: ICS system '%v' audit logs are not tamper-protected. Audit records must be write-protected and access-controlled to preserve their evidential value.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: IACS audit log access is not controlled. Only authorized personnel should be able to read audit logs; no one should be able to modify or delete them.

controls.title: IEC 62443 SR 3.9 RE 1 SL%v (SI): Audit logs are not forwarded to an immutable store. Write-once log forwarding (SIEM, syslog-ng with WORM storage) is required at Security Level 2+.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: IEC 62443 SR 3.9 RE 1 SL%v (SI): Audit logs are not forwarded to an immutable store. Write-once log forwarding (SIEM, syslog-ng with WORM storage) is required at Security Level 2+.

controls.title: IEC 62443 SR 4.1 SL%v (DC): ICS system '%v' transmits sensitive data without encryption. All sensitive IACS communications must be encrypted in transit at Security Level 2+.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: IEC 62443 SR 4.1 SL%v (DC): ICS system '%v' transmits sensitive data without encryption. All sensitive IACS communications must be encrypted in transit at Security Level 2+.

controls.title: IEC 62443 SR 4.1 SL%v (DC): ICS system '%v' does not protect data at rest. Configuration databases, historian data, and operational data must be encrypted or access-controlled at Security Level 2+.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: IEC 62443 SR 4.1 SL%v (DC): ICS system '%v' does not protect data at rest. Configuration databases, historian data, and operational data must be encrypted or access-controlled at Security Level 2+.

controls.title: IEC 62443 SR 4.1 RE 1 SL%v (DC): ICS system '%v' does not encrypt all communications in transit. At Security Level 3+, all IACS data in transit must be encrypted regardless of sensitivity classificati

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: IEC 62443 SR 4.1 RE 1 SL%v (DC): ICS system '%v' does not encrypt all communications in transit. At Security Level 3+, all IACS data in transit must be encrypted regardless of sensitivity classification.

controls.title: ICS system '%v' uses outdated TLS version. TLS 1.2 minimum is required; TLS 1.3 is recommended for IACS communications.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: ICS system '%v' uses outdated TLS version. TLS 1.2 minimum is required; TLS 1.3 is recommended for IACS communications.

parts.prose: FAIL-CLOSED - facts 'input.ics_systems' were not supplied or are empty; this module cannot be evaluated and is reported non-compliant

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: evidence missing - input.target_sl not provided; Security Level dependent requirements cannot be evaluated

controls.title: ICS system '%v' has no media sanitization procedure. Storage media must be securely sanitized before reuse or disposal to prevent residual data leakage.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: ICS system '%v' has no media sanitization procedure. Storage media must be securely sanitized before reuse or disposal to prevent residual data leakage.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: ICS system '%v' does not clear sensitive data from memory on deallocation. Cryptographic keys, passwords, and process data must be zeroed before memory is released.

controls.title: IEC 62443 SR 4.2 RE 1 SL%v (DC): ICS system '%v' has no secure deletion capability. Overwrite or cryptographic erasure of sensitive data must be available at Security Level 2+.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: IEC 62443 SR 4.2 RE 1 SL%v (DC): ICS system '%v' has no secure deletion capability. Overwrite or cryptographic erasure of sensitive data must be available at Security Level 2+.

controls.title: ICS system '%v' does not use approved cryptographic algorithms. Cryptography must be based on vetted algorithms (AES-128+, SHA-256+, RSA-2048+, or NIST-approved equivalents).

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: ICS system '%v' does not use approved cryptographic algorithms. Cryptography must be based on vetted algorithms (AES-128+, SHA-256+, RSA-2048+, or NIST-approved equivalents).

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: ICS system '%v' has no cryptographic key management. Keys must have defined generation, distribution, storage, rotation, and revocation procedures.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: ICS system '%v' has no key rotation policy. Cryptographic keys must be rotated on a defined schedule and immediately upon suspected compromise.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: ICS system '%v' uses deprecated cryptographic ciphers (DES, 3DES, RC4, MD5). These must be replaced with currently approved algorithms.

controls.title: IEC 62443 SR 4.3 RE 1 SL%v (DC): ICS system '%v' cryptographic modules are not FIPS 140-2 validated. FIPS 140-2 Level 2+ is required for cryptographic implementations at Security Level 3+.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: IEC 62443 SR 4.3 RE 1 SL%v (DC): ICS system '%v' cryptographic modules are not FIPS 140-2 validated. FIPS 140-2 Level 2+ is required for cryptographic implementations at Security Level 3+.

controls.title: No network zones defined. IEC 62443 requires the IACS to be segmented into security zones with clearly defined boundaries.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: No network zones defined. IEC 62443 requires the IACS to be segmented into security zones with clearly defined boundaries.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: IT and OT networks are not segmented. Industrial control systems must be isolated from corporate IT networks to prevent lateral movement.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: Network inventory is not documented. A complete inventory of all IACS network assets and their zone assignments is required.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: ICS systems have direct Internet connectivity. IACS must never be directly accessible from the Internet — air-gap or multi-layer DMZ is required.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: IEC 62443 SR 5.1 RE 1 SL%v (RDF): Insufficient zone segmentation. At Security Level 2+, at minimum three distinct zones are required: corporate IT, DMZ, and OT/ICS control.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Zone '%v' does not have a defined security level. Every zone must have an assigned Security Level (SL) target and capability documented.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: Conduit between zones '%v' and '%v' has no firewall or DMZ. Every zone boundary must be protected by a firewall or equivalent boundary control.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: Conduit between zones '%v' and '%v' does not filter traffic. Only explicitly authorized traffic flows must be permitted across zone boundaries.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: No DMZ is implemented between corporate IT and OT networks. A DMZ with controlled ingress/egress is required to isolate IACS from external networks.

controls.title: IEC 62443 SR 5.2 RE 1 SL%v (RDF): The IT/OT boundary between corporate and ICS control zones lacks a unidirectional gateway (data diode). Required at Security Level 3+ for critical infrastructure.

parts.prose: IEC 62443 SR 5.2 RE 1 SL%v (RDF): The IT/OT boundary between corporate and ICS control zones lacks a unidirectional gateway (data diode). Required at Security Level 3+ for critical infrastructure.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: IEC 62443 SR 5.2 RE 2 SL%v (RDF): Conduit between zones '%v' and '%v' is not encrypted. All inter-zone IACS communications must be encrypted at Security Level 3+.

controls.title: Zone '%v' (SL %v) permits unrestricted general-purpose communications (email, instant messaging). These must be restricted or prohibited within high-security IACS zones.

parts.prose: Zone '%v' (SL %v) permits unrestricted general-purpose communications (email, instant messaging). These must be restricted or prohibited within high-security IACS zones.

controls.title: IEC 62443 SR 5.3 SL%v (RDF): No policy governing general-purpose communications within IACS zones. Permitted communication types must be explicitly defined and restricted.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: IEC 62443 SR 5.3 SL%v (RDF): No policy governing general-purpose communications within IACS zones. Permitted communication types must be explicitly defined and restricted.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: ICS system '%v' does not partition IACS applications from general-purpose applications. Business applications must not run on the same platform as control applications.

parts.prose: IEC 62443 SR 5.4 RE 1 SL%v (RDF): ICS system '%v' uses a shared platform without virtualization isolation. Hypervisor-based isolation is required when IACS and non-IACS workloads share hardware at SL 2+.

controls.title: IEC 62443 SR 5.4 RE 2 SL%v (RDF): High-criticality ICS system '%v' does not run on dedicated hardware. Physical hardware separation from non-IACS workloads is required for high-criticality systems at

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: IEC 62443 SR 5.4 RE 2 SL%v (RDF): High-criticality ICS system '%v' does not run on dedicated hardware. Physical hardware separation from non-IACS workloads is required for high-criticality systems at SL 3+.

groups.title: IEC 62443-3-3 FR 6 — Timely Response to Events (TRE)

controls.title: IACS audit log access is not controlled. Logs must be accessible to authorized security and operations personnel while protected against unauthorized access.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: IACS audit log access is not controlled. Logs must be accessible to authorized security and operations personnel while protected against unauthorized access.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: IACS audit logs are retained for only %v days. Minimum 90-day retention is required to support incident investigations (1 year recommended for regulatory environments).

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: ICS system '%v' does not have audit logging enabled. Security event logs are required to enable timely detection and response.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: No ICS-specific incident response plan. OT/ICS incidents require specialized response procedures distinct from IT IR plans — a documented plan is required.

controls.title: IEC 62443 SR 6.1 RE 1 SL%v (TRE): Audit logs are not centrally collected. Centralized log management with correlation capability is required at Security Level 2+ for timely incident detection.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: IEC 62443 SR 6.1 RE 1 SL%v (TRE): Audit logs are not centrally collected. Centralized log management with correlation capability is required at Security Level 2+ for timely incident detection.

controls.title: IEC 62443 SR 6.1 RE 1 SL%v (TRE): No automated security alerting configured. Automated detection and alerting on security events is required at Security Level 2+.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: IEC 62443 SR 6.1 RE 1 SL%v (TRE): No automated security alerting configured. Automated detection and alerting on security events is required at Security Level 2+.

controls.title: No security event monitoring for IACS. Real-time or near-real-time monitoring of the IACS is required to enable timely response to incidents.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: No security event monitoring for IACS. Real-time or near-real-time monitoring of the IACS is required to enable timely response to incidents.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: IACS security monitoring is not continuous (24/7). Continuous monitoring is required — gaps in monitoring create windows of undetected intrusion.

controls.title: IEC 62443 SR 6.2 RE 1 SL%v (TRE): Mean time to detect IACS security incidents is %v hours. Target is less than 24 hours at Security Level 2+; real-time detection recommended.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: IEC 62443 SR 6.2 RE 1 SL%v (TRE): Mean time to detect IACS security incidents is %v hours. Target is less than 24 hours at Security Level 2+; real-time detection recommended.

controls.title: IEC 62443 SR 6.2 RE 1 SL%v (TRE): Mean time to respond to IACS security incidents is %v hours. Target is less than 4 hours at Security Level 2+.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: IEC 62443 SR 6.2 RE 1 SL%v (TRE): Mean time to respond to IACS security incidents is %v hours. Target is less than 4 hours at Security Level 2+.

controls.title: IEC 62443 SR 6.2 RE 2 SL%v (TRE): No ICS-specific Security Operations Center (SOC) capability. At Security Level 3+, OT-aware monitoring personnel or an OT-SOC is required.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: IEC 62443 SR 6.2 RE 2 SL%v (TRE): No ICS-specific Security Operations Center (SOC) capability. At Security Level 3+, OT-aware monitoring personnel or an OT-SOC is required.

controls.title: IEC 62443 SR 6.2 RE 3 SL%v (TRE): Threat intelligence is not integrated into IACS monitoring. ICS-CERT/CISA advisories and sector-specific threat feeds must be operationalized at Security Level 3+.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: IEC 62443 SR 6.2 RE 3 SL%v (TRE): Threat intelligence is not integrated into IACS monitoring. ICS-CERT/CISA advisories and sector-specific threat feeds must be operationalized at Security Level 3+.

controls.title: IEC 62443 SR 6.2 RE 4 SL%v (TRE): No anomaly-based detection for IACS. Behavioral anomaly detection is required at Security Level 4 to detect sophisticated, previously unseen attacks.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: IEC 62443 SR 6.2 RE 4 SL%v (TRE): No anomaly-based detection for IACS. Behavioral anomaly detection is required at Security Level 4 to detect sophisticated, previously unseen attacks.

controls.title: No DoS protection for IACS network. Industrial control systems must be protected against denial-of-service attacks that could disrupt critical operations.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: No DoS protection for IACS network. Industrial control systems must be protected against denial-of-service attacks that could disrupt critical operations.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: ICS system '%v' has no rate limiting. Rate limiting on communication interfaces prevents resource exhaustion from DoS attacks.

controls.title: IEC 62443 SR 7.1 RE 1 SL%v (RA): No active DoS traffic management implemented. Intrusion prevention, traffic shaping, or equivalent controls are required at Security Level 2+.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: IEC 62443 SR 7.1 RE 1 SL%v (RA): No active DoS traffic management implemented. Intrusion prevention, traffic shaping, or equivalent controls are required at Security Level 2+.

controls.title: IEC 62443 SR 7.1 RE 2 SL%v (RA): No redundant network paths for critical IACS communications. Network redundancy is required at Security Level 3+ to maintain availability under partial failure.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: IEC 62443 SR 7.1 RE 2 SL%v (RA): No redundant network paths for critical IACS communications. Network redundancy is required at Security Level 3+ to maintain availability under partial failure.

controls.title: ICS system '%v' does not monitor resource usage. CPU, memory, disk, and network resource utilization must be monitored with alerts for degraded capacity.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: ICS system '%v' does not monitor resource usage. CPU, memory, disk, and network resource utilization must be monitored with alerts for degraded capacity.

controls.title: IEC 62443 SR 7.2 RE 1 SL%v (RA): ICS system '%v' has no resource limits configured. Resource quotas must be enforced to prevent a single process or user from exhausting system resources.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: IEC 62443 SR 7.2 RE 1 SL%v (RA): ICS system '%v' has no resource limits configured. Resource quotas must be enforced to prevent a single process or user from exhausting system resources.

controls.title: ICS system '%v' has no backup configured. Regular backups of IACS configuration, logic, and data are required for recovery.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: ICS system '%v' has no backup configured. Regular backups of IACS configuration, logic, and data are required for recovery.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: IACS backups are performed every %v days. Backups must be performed at least weekly; daily backups are recommended for critical systems.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: IACS backups are not stored offsite. Offsite or geographically separated backup storage is required to survive a site-level disaster.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: IACS backup restoration has not been tested. Backups must be periodically tested for recoverability — an untested backup is not a reliable backup.

controls.title: IEC 62443 SR 7.3 RE 1 SL%v (RA): IACS backups are not encrypted at rest. Backup media containing IACS configuration and data must be encrypted at Security Level 2+.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: IEC 62443 SR 7.3 RE 1 SL%v (RA): IACS backups are not encrypted at rest. Backup media containing IACS configuration and data must be encrypted at Security Level 2+.

controls.title: ICS system '%v' has no documented recovery procedure. A step-by-step recovery procedure enabling restoration to a known secure state is required.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: ICS system '%v' has no documented recovery procedure. A step-by-step recovery procedure enabling restoration to a known secure state is required.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: High-criticality ICS system '%v' has an RTO of %v hours. Critical IACS systems must achieve recovery within 24 hours; 4 hours or less is recommended.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: No rollback capability for IACS updates/patches. The ability to revert to a previous known-good state is required for all IACS changes.

controls.title: IEC 62443 SR 7.4 RE 1 SL%v (RA): IACS recovery plan has not been tested. At Security Level 2+, recovery procedures must be exercised at least annually.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: IEC 62443 SR 7.4 RE 1 SL%v (RA): IACS recovery plan has not been tested. At Security Level 2+, recovery procedures must be exercised at least annually.

controls.title: High-criticality ICS system '%v' has no emergency power backup (UPS/generator). Uninterrupted power is required for critical industrial control systems.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: High-criticality ICS system '%v' has no emergency power backup (UPS/generator). Uninterrupted power is required for critical industrial control systems.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: ICS system '%v' emergency power backup has not been tested. UPS/generator systems must be tested at least semi-annually to verify runtime and automatic switchover.

controls.title: IEC 62443 SR 7.5 SL%v (RA): ICS system '%v' has no emergency power backup. Emergency power capability is required at Security Level 2+ for all IACS components.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: IEC 62443 SR 7.5 SL%v (RA): ICS system '%v' has no emergency power backup. Emergency power capability is required at Security Level 2+ for all IACS components.

controls.title: ICS system '%v' has no documented configuration baseline. A hardened baseline configuration must be documented and enforced.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: ICS system '%v' has no documented configuration baseline. A hardened baseline configuration must be documented and enforced.

controls.title: IEC 62443 SR 7.6 RE 1 SL%v (RA): No configuration change management process. All changes to IACS network and security configurations must go through a formal change control process.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: IEC 62443 SR 7.6 RE 1 SL%v (RA): No configuration change management process. All changes to IACS network and security configurations must go through a formal change control process.

controls.title: ICS system '%v' has unnecessary services enabled. Disable all services, protocols, and ports not required for IACS operation to reduce the attack surface.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: ICS system '%v' has unnecessary services enabled. Disable all services, protocols, and ports not required for IACS operation to reduce the attack surface.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: ICS system '%v' OS has not been hardened. Remove unnecessary OS components, disable unused features, and apply a hardening standard (CIS benchmark or equivalent).

controls.title: IEC 62443 SR 7.7 RE 1 SL%v (RA): No periodic review of IACS enabled functionality. Enabled services, protocols, and functions must be reviewed at least annually at Security Level 2+.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: IEC 62443 SR 7.7 RE 1 SL%v (RA): No periodic review of IACS enabled functionality. Enabled services, protocols, and functions must be reviewed at least annually at Security Level 2+.

controls.title: ICS system '%v' is not documented in the IACS component inventory. Every IACS component must be inventoried with hardware, software, firmware versions, and network information.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: ICS system '%v' is not documented in the IACS component inventory. Every IACS component must be inventoried with hardware, software, firmware versions, and network information.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: Network inventory is not documented. A complete, up-to-date asset inventory of all IACS network components is required.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: ICS system '%v' is running an outdated OS version. Inventory data must be current and unsupported OS versions must be remediated or documented as accepted risk.

controls.title: IEC 62443 SR 7.8 RE 1 SL%v (RA): No automated asset discovery for IACS. Automated inventory discovery or network scanning tools are required at Security Level 2+ to detect unauthorized devices.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: IEC 62443 SR 7.8 RE 1 SL%v (RA): No automated asset discovery for IACS. Automated inventory discovery or network scanning tools are required at Security Level 2+ to detect unauthorized devices.

groups.title: IEC 62443-2-3 — Patch Management in the IACS Environment

controls.title: No patch management process documented for IACS. A formal process for identifying, evaluating, testing, and applying security patches is required.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: No patch management process documented for IACS. A formal process for identifying, evaluating, testing, and applying security patches is required.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: No vendor security notification subscriptions. Subscribe to ICS-CERT, vendor security advisories, and sector-specific vulnerability feeds to receive timely patch notifications.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: Patch status is not tracked for IACS components. Maintain a current patch inventory for all IACS hardware and software components.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: Patch status for ICS system '%v' is not documented. Every IACS component must have a documented patch status, including exceptions and compensating controls for unpatched vulnerabilities.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: IACS patches are not tested before production deployment. Patches must be evaluated in an isolated test environment that mirrors the production IACS before deployment — untested patches can cause operational failures.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: No dedicated patch testing environment for IACS. A test environment replicating the production IACS is required for safe patch qualification.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: Critical IACS patches are delayed up to %v days. Critical security patches must be deployed within 90 days; within 30 days for actively exploited vulnerabilities.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: No documented patch deployment schedule. A maintenance window schedule for IACS patches must be established that balances security and operational continuity.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: Patch management is not integrated with change management. All IACS patches must go through the formal change management process to maintain configuration control.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: No emergency patch procedure defined. A documented emergency patch procedure for critical/zero-day vulnerabilities is required for timely response.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: No rollback capability for IACS patches. The ability to revert to a pre-patch state is required in case a patch causes operational issues.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: No compensating controls defined for unpatched IACS vulnerabilities. When patching is not immediately feasible, compensating controls (network isolation, additional monitoring, vendor mitigations) must be documented and implemented.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: ICS system '%v' is running an outdated OS version. Unsupported or unpatched operating systems represent unacceptable risk in an IACS environment.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: ICS system '%v' firmware is not current. Outdated firmware may contain unmitigated vulnerabilities — apply vendor-recommended firmware updates following the patch testing process.

controls.title: No documented Cyber Security Management System. A CSMS addressing people, process, and technology controls for the IACS is required.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: No documented Cyber Security Management System. A CSMS addressing people, process, and technology controls for the IACS is required.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: IACS cybersecurity policy has not been approved by senior management. Management authorization and ownership of the security policy is required.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: IACS security policy is reviewed every %v months. Policy must be reviewed at least annually and after any significant incident or organizational change.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: Security roles and responsibilities are not defined. Ownership of each security control, including an IACS Security Manager role, must be assigned.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: No IACS risk management process. A formal process for identifying, assessing, and treating cybersecurity risks to the IACS is required.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: No IACS cybersecurity risk assessment has been conducted. A risk assessment is the foundation for all security decisions.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: IACS risk assessment is reviewed every %v months. Risk assessments must be reviewed at least every 24 months or after significant system changes.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: IACS asset inventory is incomplete. A complete asset inventory is a prerequisite for risk assessment and security program effectiveness.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: No threat modeling performed for IACS. Threat modeling (identifying realistic threat actors and attack vectors) must inform risk treatment decisions.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: No consequence analysis performed. Impact analysis of cyber incidents on safety, operations, environment, and business continuity is required.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: No security awareness training for IACS personnel. All employees with IACS access must receive role-appropriate cybersecurity training.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: IACS security training is conducted every %v months. Training must be conducted at least annually.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: No IACS incident response capability. A documented ICS-specific incident response plan with trained personnel and clear escalation paths is required.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: No supply chain security program for IACS. Security requirements must extend to OT vendors, integrators, and managed service providers with IACS access.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: Security requirements are not imposed on third parties. All vendors and contractors with IACS access must meet defined security requirements (ref: IEC 62443-2-4).

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: No security metrics tracked. The CSMS must define and track key performance indicators (KPIs) for measuring security effectiveness.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: No CSMS audit conducted. The CSMS must be periodically audited against the defined objectives and requirements.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: CSMS audits are conducted every %v months. Audits must be conducted at least every 24 months.

groups.title: IEC 62443-2-4 — Security Program Requirements for IACS Service Providers

controls.title: IACS service provider has no documented security program. A formal security management program addressing all IEC 62443-2-4 requirements is required.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: IACS service provider has no documented security program. A formal security management program addressing all IEC 62443-2-4 requirements is required.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: No vulnerability disclosure process. The service provider must have a defined process for disclosing and responding to vulnerabilities in supplied IACS products or services.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: FAIL-CLOSED - facts 'input.service_provider' were not supplied; this module cannot be evaluated and is reported non-compliant

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: evidence missing - input.is_iacs_service_provider not provided; applicability of the service provider requirements cannot be determined

controls.title: No background checks for IACS field personnel. Personnel with physical or logical access to customer IACS must undergo appropriate background screening.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: No background checks for IACS field personnel. Personnel with physical or logical access to customer IACS must undergo appropriate background screening.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: No security training for IACS field staff. Personnel performing IACS integration, installation, or maintenance must be trained on relevant cybersecurity practices.

controls.title: Customer IACS security requirements have not been reviewed. The service provider must formally review and acknowledge customer security requirements before commencing work.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Customer IACS security requirements have not been reviewed. The service provider must formally review and acknowledge customer security requirements before commencing work.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: No security measures during installation/commissioning. The service provider must implement appropriate security controls during IACS installation to prevent introduction of vulnerabilities.

controls.title: Security documentation has not been provided to the customer. Service providers must deliver security documentation (hardening guides, default credentials list, known vulnerabilities) for all supplied

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Security documentation has not been provided to the customer. Service providers must deliver security documentation (hardening guides, default credentials list, known vulnerabilities) for all supplied IACS components.

controls.title: Remote access to customer IACS is not security-controlled. All service provider remote access must go through customer-approved, auditable channels (VPN/jump host) with explicit session authorization.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Remote access to customer IACS is not security-controlled. All service provider remote access must go through customer-approved, auditable channels (VPN/jump host) with explicit session authorization.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: MFA is not enforced for service provider remote access. Multi-factor authentication is required for all remote IACS access by service providers.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: Remote service provider sessions are not audit logged. All remote access sessions must be logged and the logs made available to the asset owner.

controls.title: No policy for temporary connections to IACS. Laptops, diagnostic tools, and temporary devices connected to IACS must be controlled by a formal policy requiring malware scanning, configuration hardenin

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: No policy for temporary connections to IACS. Laptops, diagnostic tools, and temporary devices connected to IACS must be controlled by a formal policy requiring malware scanning, configuration hardening, and session logging.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: No portable tool security policy. Service provider laptops and diagnostic tools used on IACS must be hardened, maintained, and free of unauthorized software.

controls.title: Service provider portable tools lack malware protection. All tools connected to customer IACS must have current malware protection to prevent introduction of malicious code.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Service provider portable tools lack malware protection. All tools connected to customer IACS must have current malware protection to prevent introduction of malicious code.

controls.title: No patch qualification process for supplied IACS systems. Service providers must qualify and communicate security patches for all IACS products they supply or maintain.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: No patch qualification process for supplied IACS systems. Service providers must qualify and communicate security patches for all IACS products they supply or maintain.

controls.title: No security event notification capability. Service providers must notify asset owners of security events that may affect their IACS within defined timeframes.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: No security event notification capability. Service providers must notify asset owners of security events that may affect their IACS within defined timeframes.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: Security event notification SLA is %v hours. Service providers must notify asset owners of critical security events within 24 hours; immediately for active incidents.

groups.title: IEC 62443-3-2 — Security Risk Assessment for System Design

controls.title: No cybersecurity risk assessment has been conducted. A formal risk assessment is the foundation for all IEC 62443 security decisions and must precede system design or security level assignment.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: No cybersecurity risk assessment has been conducted. A formal risk assessment is the foundation for all IEC 62443 security decisions and must precede system design or security level assignment.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: Asset inventory is incomplete. A complete inventory of all IACS assets (hardware, software, firmware, communication paths) is a prerequisite for risk assessment.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: No threat modeling performed. Threat modeling (identifying threat actors, threat vectors, and attack scenarios) is required to understand the IACS threat landscape.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: No consequence analysis performed. The impact of potential cyber incidents on safety, operations, environment, financial, and reputation must be analyzed.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: No vulnerability assessment performed. Identify vulnerabilities in IACS components through analysis of known CVEs, configuration weaknesses, and architectural gaps.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: IACS cybersecurity risks have not been formally identified and documented. Risk register with likelihood, consequence, and risk rating is required.

controls.title: Zones and conduits have not been formally defined. Partitioning the IACS into security zones and defining conduits between zones is a core IEC 62443 architectural requirement.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Zones and conduits have not been formally defined. Partitioning the IACS into security zones and defining conduits between zones is a core IEC 62443 architectural requirement.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: No security zones defined. The IACS must be divided into security zones based on criticality, function, and required security level.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: Zone '%v' has no documented risk assessment. Each zone must have a zone-specific risk assessment driving its target security level assignment.

controls.title: Target security levels (SL-T) have not been assigned per zone. Each zone must have a SL-T derived from the risk assessment results (SL 1–4).

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Target security levels (SL-T) have not been assigned per zone. Each zone must have a SL-T derived from the risk assessment results (SL 1–4).

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: Zone '%v' does not have a defined security level. All zones must have an explicit SL-T (1–4) based on the zone risk assessment.

parts.name: assessment-objective
parts.prose: High-criticality zone '%v' has Security Level %v. High-criticality IACS zones should have SL-T of at least 2 (SL 3 or 4 recommended for BES and safety-critical systems).

controls.title: High-level security requirements (HLSRs) have not been derived from the risk assessment. HLSRs form the basis for selecting and implementing specific security controls (mapped to IEC 62443-3-3 SRs).

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: High-level security requirements (HLSRs) have not been derived from the risk assessment. HLSRs form the basis for selecting and implementing specific security controls (mapped to IEC 62443-3-3 SRs).

controls.title: Residual risk after security control implementation has not been formally evaluated and accepted. Senior management must accept documented residual risk.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Residual risk after security control implementation has not been formally evaluated and accepted. Senior management must accept documented residual risk.

controls.title: Risk assessment review cycle is %v months. IACS risk assessments must be reviewed at least every 24 months and after significant changes (new systems, topology changes, incident).
